description: Combine every available official BTS crossing measure for one land-border port into a provenance-backed current-versus-prior activity evidence pack. Keeps trucks, trains, buses, vehicles, passengers, and pedestrians separate while reporting window totals, completeness, and percent change. Use this for 'build a border activity pack for Laredo', 'what changed at Otay Mesa?', or a logistics/corridor briefing. It never fabricates a total across incompatible measures and is not a congestion or wait-time measure.

port.description: Exact BTS four-digit port code or an unambiguous U.S. land-border port name. Search first when needed.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

trailing_months.description: Months per current/prior comparison window. Default 12.

name: bts_transport_border_activity_pack
